peak_days: Trayodashi Tithi Tuesdays, Wednesdays, Sankatahara Chaturthi, Kritika Nakshatra days, Shashti Tithis
peak_seasons: Maha Shivaratri, Sankranti, Brahmotsavam, Vijayadashami (Ayudha Puja)
average_wait_time: 30 to 45 minutes on standard weekdays; 1 to 1.5hours on standard weekends (Saturdays, Sundays, and Mondays).
peak_wait_time: 3 to 6 hours during major festivals like Maha Shivaratri and peak Brahmotsavam days.
recommended_visiting_hours: Early morning for quick entry, or mid-week days (Tuesday morning to Thursday afternoon) when general crowd volumes are historically at their lowest.
crowd_management_notes: Devasthanam regulations must be followed during viewings of Archana Abhishekam, Utsavas, and festival queues.
